paperClaim: The frozen external challenge set contains 413 model-visible request-side samples with confidentially human-reviewed reference labels.
limitations: The review is operator-attested and raw reviewer materials are restricted; the set is not natural production traffic.
allowedWording: The frozen evaluation contains 413 request-side samples (safe=209, attack=97, unknown=107); the AI-assisted reference labels were subsequently confirmed through confidential blind human review with zero label changes.
forbiddenWording: The benchmark is representative production traffic, publicly reproducible raw human annotation, or infallible objective ground truth.

paperClaim: The primary model achieved the reported verdict scores on the frozen set.
limitations: Single frozen set; finite-sample confidence interval.
allowedWording: AetherArgus HF-LoRA achieved accuracy 0.6150 (95% CI 0.5835-0.6441) and macro-F1 0.4658 (95% CI 0.4415-0.4894).
forbiddenWording: AetherArgus is universally more capable than every baseline in all deployments.

paperClaim: The primary model's observed safe false-positive rate and exact interval.
limitations: An observed rate is not proof of population risk.
allowedWording: Observed safe FPR was 43/209 (Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound 0.2670).
forbiddenWording: The model has no false positives or zero population FPR.

paperClaim: AetherArgus HF-LoRA improves over Qwen3-4B zero-shot on paired frozen-set tests.
limitations: Significance applies to this frozen set only.
allowedWording: On this frozen set, macro-F1 delta was +0.0482 with 95% CI [+0.0113,+0.0835], and Holm-corrected McNemar p=8.358e-07.
forbiddenWording: AetherArgus significantly outperforms every model in all settings.

paperClaim: Transformers merged BF16 and Ollama f16 agree under byte-identical serialized prompts on this set.
limitations: The artifacts are not bit-identical and runtime remains coupled to representation.
allowedWording: With byte-identical serialized prompts the two paths agreed on 413/413 verdicts on the frozen set.
forbiddenWording: The runtimes or artifacts are numerically identical or any difference is caused solely by quantization.

paperClaim: Confidential blind human review confirmed the frozen labels without changes.
limitations: Reviewer identities, count, worksheets, and raw materials are not publicly released.
allowedWording: A confidential blind human review conducted outside the public repository covered all 413 samples, found zero disagreements, and required zero label changes.
forbiddenWording: The repository publishes independently auditable raw human worksheets or reviewer identities.
